# Swaption volatility cube (`ir-vol-cube` v1)

Normal (bp) swaption vols by expiry × tenor.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `IRV` · **Identifiers:** `IRV-…` in `cubeId`

Open one with `IRV <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: ir-vol-cube
version: 1
description: Normal (bp) swaption vols by expiry × tenor.
match: { kind: ir-vol-cube, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Swaption volatility cube, id: $.cubeId }
strip:
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
  - { label: Model, bind: $.model }
  - { label: "1Y×10Y", bind: $.v1y10y, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: "5Y×5Y", bind: $.v5y5y, fmt: price2 }
panels:
  - id: grid
    kind: table
    title: ATM normal vols (bp)
    key: F2
    rows: $.grid
    columns:
      - { label: Expiry, bind: "@.expiry" }
      - { label: "1Y", bind: "@.t1Y", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "2Y", bind: "@.t2Y", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "5Y", bind: "@.t5Y", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "10Y", bind: "@.t10Y", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: "30Y", bind: "@.t30Y", fmt: price2 }
  - id: row10y
    kind: line
    title: "10Y tenor by expiry"
    area: right
    rows: $.grid
    x: expiry
    y: t10Y
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
